amends.reason: The preregistered Claude Haiku 4.5 0.75 arm completed provider calls but failed the pre-specified raw-budget and row-completeness gates. The failed arm remains an immutable provider-feasibility result and is not included in matched inference.
amends.replacement_policy: Replace the failed Anthropic replication cohort with a Google Gemini 3.5 Flash cohort while preserving all prompts, information conditions, budget definitions, row universe, parser, simulator, Oracle evaluators, quality gates, and multiplicity contracts. Reuse the four already completed GPT-5.4-mini archives without new OpenAI calls.

primary_claim: The sign and magnitude of reference-free self-revision and conditional reference-content increments vary with generation-time action capacity.

seed_protocol.interpretation: Seed fields identify run/reference metadata only; provider stochasticity remains residual.

primary_multiplicity.family: within cohort x finite arm x component, Holm across alpha/beta/gamma

sensitivity_multiplicity.family: within cohort x component, Holm across 3 finite arms x 3 Oracles

equivalence.basis: frozen thesis alpha C3-vs-C2 firm-paired MDE80
equivalence.boundary: No beta/gamma equivalence claim is made until scale-specific margins are separately frozen.

stopping_rule: Stop before the next newly generated live arm if any required payload archive, row-alignment, candidate-library version, or finite-arm compliance gate fails. Reused archives must satisfy the same arm requirements before they enter the amended grid. Do not change prompts or exclusions after observing replacement outcomes; issue a new amendment instead.
pooling_policy: Analyze each backend cohort separately. Cross-backend output is a replication table, not a pooled treatment estimate.

replacement_pilot_policy.pilot_pass_condition: The existing arm QC verifier must PASS without relaxed thresholds.
replacement_pilot_policy.completion_policy: A later full amended grid may reuse the successful pilot archive and the four frozen GPT-5.4-mini archives; remaining Gemini arms are newly generated.
